proposition.claim:
A Polishable subgroup H in D(Pi^0_2)(G) has a potentially Sigma^0_2 coset relation; Lemma6.5 claims this even for Sigma^0_3 subgroups.

G is Polish; H is an additive Polishable subgroup. Finite-variation sequences form F_sigma via closed partial-sum sublevels. L={liminf|x_n|=0} is G_delta. Finite variation implies convergence, so H=BV intersect L is in D(Pi^0_2), hence Sigma^0_3.
